gaps.desktop: The loser signals repetition only with a tiny (~8px) repeat glyph perched on the top-right rim of the ~24px circled calendar icon inside the '26 Aug' chip, and never states the rule, so you cannot tell how it repeats (or even the weekday) without opening the picker. The winner puts a ~14px repeat icon plus the rule 'Every Monday' in ~13px grey text right beside a bold 'Mon, Aug 26'. Fix: drop the overlapping badge and add an inline repeat icon + rule label (e.g. 'Every Monday') after the date inside or next to the chip, and include the weekday in the date.

why: Winner shows date with weekday and the explicit repeat rule inline at readable size; loser hides repetition in a tiny corner badge with no rule.
